label: AB2CD5_oI36_46_b_c_a_b2c-001
title: Brownmillerite (Ca$_{2}$(Fe$_{2-x}$Al$_{x}$)O$_{5}$) Structure
comments:
The Fe (4a) and Al (4b) sites are alloyed.  In the current sample the (4a) site is 84.9\% iron and 15.1\% aluminum, while the (4b) site is 56.1\% iron and 43.9\% aluminum.  We label the (4b) site as aluminium to separate it from the (4a) site. 
 When x $<$ 0.56 the structure transforms into a \href{current_web_home_dir/AB2CD5_oI36_46_b_c_a_b2c-001}{simple orthorhombic structure} (Redhammer, 2004), while the stoichiometric (x = 0) structure transforms to this structure above 950K (Shaula, 2006). 
 (Redhammer, 2004) give this structure in the $I2mb$ setting of space group \#46.  We use AFLOW to transform it into the standard $Ima2$ setting.
